description: Source code for the CocoPanoptic dataset class and build function, used for loading and processing COCO panoptic segmentation data in an object detection framework.

classes.name: CocoPanoptic
classes.description: A dataset class for loading and processing COCO panoptic segmentation data, providing images and annotations for training or evaluation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the dataset with image and annotation folders, loads COCO JSON, and sorts images.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Retrieves an image and its annotations, processes masks and labels, and applies transformations.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the number of images in the dataset.

methods.name: get_height_and_width
methods.description: Returns the height and width of the image at a given index.
